verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships a built-in agent platform with MCP tool support, so event-triggered automation is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack documents no user-defined rules, triggers, or event-driven actions. Agents, tool calling, MCP connections and approval-gated shell commands are all invoked on demand, and model preloading is startup configuration rather than a rule engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
